failureHistory.finding: The 16-case combination retained one 30-second account cancellation. The isolated account observation reached the end of all four start/resume flows and exposed an exact-list mismatch: the installed readonly entry explicitly requests native codemode, while the source-only flag fixture registers only four physical read tools. The correction selects the exact registry by the frozen native Pi contract and adds a real native nested-write rejection without removing direct-write, account, credential, usage, thinking, history, receive-count or deadline assertions. The first red remains; it is not counted as a candidate pass.

Both initial and quiescent combinations retained 15 PASS and one 30-second account cancellation. failureHistory.epoch: candidate-8 / GUI setup and first model picker
failureHistory.kind: preserved native browser controls and explicit account setup
failureHistory.finding: Initial unsupported selector, collapsed static-provider form, pointer interception and screenshot timeout were retained. The first full driver stopped at the model picker with an empty account credential store. After an explicit native Save Credentials click, the real SDK returned exactly fixture/one; independent chat and nonchat receives were still zero before the successful business journey. No source or candidate byte changed, no fallback account was used.

The initial input driver retained the full controlled reply scenario and stopped while waiting for separately authorized model budgets. The existing task and three inputs were preserved. A continuation explicitly approved the already-delivered local model work and selected ordinary replies for future turns; it did not resend a prompt or input. The initial input task retained one failed parent codemode script; its subsequent native consumption and all additional controlled model receipts remain. A separate correctly preset input journey on the same candidate uses new inputs BASE4/STEER4/QUEUE_FOUR and asserts both associated tasks succeed with every tool completed. Its tool and consumption checks remain supplemental; final acceptance uses I5, which also retains independent request bodies. No failed parent is counted as a clean pass.

The original driver had already cancelled the native task and persisted the paused/removed queue evidence, then pointer interception stopped it before opening recovery. A subsequent stop-focused probe found no stop button; independent Host readback confirmed cancelled, one paused and one removed item. Recovery continued from those same input IDs through the explicit confirmation, without another stop or resubmission.

Initial high-level and Page.captureScreenshot calls timed out; Monaco also remained at zero layout size. Activating the existing Ego Lite app restored visible/nonzero layout and screenshot capture. Current candidate editor and terminal screenshots are inspected before native mouse/keyboard actions, with independent saved-file/PTY readback. No browser was substituted and no editor model was mutated programmatically; earlier failures and historical screenshots remain.

I4 native input consumption and all tools passed, but the resource fixture retained only the independent chat count, not request bodies. The missing body proof is NOT_CAPTURED, not inferred absent. Final I5 input acceptance uses the same candidate and existing body-recording main fixture in a fresh isolated profile, with new input IDs and no resubmission; both tasks and every tool must complete, and actual independent request bodies must exclude those IDs. Earlier valid I4 consumption remains supplemental.
